subject: Learning Methods
title: Reading with a Purpose
description: A fast breakdown of Reading with a Purpose for builders.

hook.text: Two people read the same article. One looked for arguments. The other looked for data.

buildup.text: Having a reading purpose activates selective attention. You filter for what matters and ignore what doesn't serve.

discovery.text: Without a purpose, everything gets equal weight. With one, your brain prioritizes relevant information automatically.

twist.text: Reading with a Purpose shows that effective learning often feels harder in the moment.

climax.text: Before opening any text, ask: why am I reading this? What do I need to extract? Let the answer guide your strategy.

punchline.text: Know why you're reading before you start reading.

quiz.question: How does having a reading purpose help comprehension?
options: It activates selective attention to filter for relevant information
It eliminates the need for rereading
